claims.claim: AFFN was founded in 1985 at the request of the U.S. Army to support the Surepay direct-deposit system, giving military personnel ATM and POS access near bases worldwide.
claims.quote: AFFN was founded in 1985 at the request of the U.S. Army in support of the Surepay direct deposit system
claims.title: About Us - AFFN
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: AFFN is co-owned by two trade associations, the Association of Military Banks of America (AMBA) and the Defense Credit Union Council (DCUC); no ownership change since 2020 is published on the site.
claims.quote: AFFN is co-owned by the Association of Military Banks of America (AMBA) and the Defense Credit Union Council (DCUC).
claims.title: About Us - AFFN
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Site copyright 2026. Wikipedia reference 1 cites a Bloomberg profile of 'Armed Forces Financial Network, LLC' (2018 archive), so legal form appears to be an LLC.

claims.claim: AFFN describes itself as an EFT network giving military, veteran and civilian communities access to funds through ATM and POS terminals at or near U.S. military bases worldwide, in operation for more than 40 years.
claims.quote: an electronic transfer network (EFT) providing network access to the U.S. military, veteran, and civilian communities
claims.title: Armed Forces Financial Network - Home
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Homepage also says 'For more than 40 years'.

claims.claim: AFFN headquarters address is 11601 Roosevelt Blvd TA-94, St. Petersburg, FL 33716, which is an FIS campus address; the site is built on an FIS Sitecore theme and links its Privacy page to fisglobal.com.
claims.quote: 11601 Roosevelt Blvd. TA-94 Saint Petersburg, FL 33716
claims.title: Contact Us - AFFN
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Raw HTML references /-/media/Themes/FIS/AFFN/ stylesheets and footer Privacy link https://www.fisglobal.com/en/privacy, indicating FIS (NYCE's owner) hosts/operates the site. CEO John Broda's grant-program phone is a 302 (Delaware) number.

claims.claim: NYCE (FIS) states that its cardholders reach ATMs on U.S. military bases worldwide through NYCE's partnership with AFFN, alongside 90%+ U.S. ATM coverage and 2M+ retail locations.
claims.quote: Access cash at over 90% of ATMs nationwide, 24/7 – plus U.S. military bases worldwide through NYCE's partnership with AFFN®.
claims.title: NYCE Payments Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: NYCE FAQ repeats: 'NYCE cardholders also have ATM access at U.S. military bases worldwide through the AFFN® network.' (https://www.nyce.net/faqs.html).

claims.claim: Wikipedia (citing 2018-archived DCUC and CUInsight items) puts AFFN at about 346 banks and credit unions, 800,000+ ATMs and 2.3 million POS locations; affn.org publishes no such counts.
claims.quote: It connects approximately 346 banks and credit unions with over 800,000 ATMs and 2.3 million point-of-sale locations
claims.title: Armed Forces Financial Network - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Figures are stale (sources archived Jan 2018). Wikipedia also says AFFN launched a chip-and-PIN travel card in 2017 (citing an AMBA item dated 6 Aug 2013).

claims.claim: Co-owner DCUC represents over 180 federal and state-chartered credit unions serving the U.S. military, giving a ceiling on the credit-union side of AFFN participation.
claims.quote: a trade association representing the interests of over 180 federal and state-chartered credit unions serving the U.S. military around the world
claims.title: About Us - AFFN
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: AFFN's merchant-side product is AFFN POS, described as an international PIN-based (single-message) POS payment system with hundreds of thousands of merchant locations across eight retail sectors (Walmart, Costco, Shell, CVS, USPS named).
claims.quote: AFFN® POS offers cardholders a convenient and secure card-based payment alternative to cash, share draft/checking or credit cards.
claims.title: Debit Point of Sale - AFFN
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Page describes an 'international PIN-based (POS) payment system for cardholders and retailers/merchants' and 'hundreds of thousands of merchant locations globally'. PIN-based implies single-message debit; no dual-message product is described.

claims.claim: The AFFN Matching Grant Program, authorised by the AFFN board, gives participating AMBA banks and DCUC credit unions up to $1,500 matched per participant, first-come first-served, one application each; 2026 is its 23rd consecutive year with 1,158 grants awarded since 2004.
claims.quote: This program will allow a maximum matching grant up to $1,500 per Participant.
claims.title: AFFN Matching Grant Program - AFFN
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Contact: John Broda, AFFN President and CEO, 302-604-3430, John.Broda@affn.org. Downloadable application form on page.

claims.claim: AFFN supports the Veterans Benefits Banking Program (VBBP), under which participating banks and credit unions must offer a no-monthly-fee, no-minimum-balance checking account to VA benefit recipients bringing a monthly direct deposit.
claims.quote: a low-to-no-cost checking account (no monthly maintenance fees) and no minimum balance, to a VA benefit recipient
claims.title: VBBP - AFFN
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: VBBP established 2019 between VA and AMBA; participants complete a commitment form and supply logo, landing-page URL and description.

claims.claim: The only public rule document is the AFFN Graphic Standards Manual: all entities permitted to use the Licensed Marks must follow it, and participants are responsible for their vendors' compliance; no operating rulebook, fee schedule or dispute framework is published.
claims.quote: all entities permitted to use the Licensed Marks must adhere to these graphic standards
claims.title: AFFN Graphic Standards - AFFN
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Logo, acronym and name files downloadable in EPS/JPG/PNG. Compliance questions: 727-227-2880 or info@affn.org.

claims.claim: affn.org carries a Login link at /login in its header (commented out in the current HTML); the URL returns a 200 page with no visible content, so a participant login exists or existed but is not documented.
claims.quote: Contact Us Login --> Services AFFN Matching Grant Program
claims.title: Login - AFFN
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: The 'Login' anchor and a 'Financial Institutions Search' link are wrapped in HTML comments; /resources/financial-institutions-search returns 404.

claims.claim: The public marketing site (affn.org) is readable without an account and exposes Services (grant program, annual meetings, debit POS), Resources (videos and testimonials, VBBP, graphic standards, other links, military services, important dates), VOB Support and About/Contact; there is no developer, spec, status, bulletin or support portal.
claims.quote: AFFN Home | About Us | Resources | Services | Privacy | Contact Us
claims.title: Resources - AFFN
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Other Links page lists FIS (http://www.fisglobal.com) among partner links alongside DoD, VA, DCUC, AMBA, AAFES, DeCA, USO.

claims.claim: AFFN publishes a single phone line, fax and general email plus named executives by department: President & CEO John M. Broda; SVP Member Experience Ann Morsch; Senior Director Member Services & Operations Rhonda Wilson; VPs Member Engagement Scott Duszynski and Christopher Kelly; VP Finance Karmelita Sewell. No hours, languages or SLAs are stated.
claims.title: Contact Us - AFFN
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Account-management model appears to be named 'Member Engagement' VPs; no ticketing or support portal.

claims.claim: AFFN's partner events are its co-owners' conferences: AMBA Military Banking Summit MBS2026, September 27-29, 2026 at the Mayflower Hotel, Washington D.C., and the 63rd Annual DCUC Conference, August 3-7, 2026 at JW Marriott Miami Turnberry.
claims.title: AFFN Partner Annual Meetings - AFFN
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: No AFFN-run training, academy or certification is published.

claims.claim: AFFN claims a 100% referral rating and 100% member satisfaction rating from participants on its testimonials page, with video testimonials from Andrews FCU and Fisher House; AMBA bank testimonials are marked coming soon.
claims.title: AFFN Videos & Member Testimonials - AFFN
claims.label: Vendor

claims.claim: In 2026 AFFN's homepage announces Ann Morsch's promotion to Senior Vice President/Member Experience and congratulates Karmelita Sewell (VP Finance); no date is given.
claims.quote: Congratulations Ann Morsch on Your Promotion to Senior Vice President/Member Experience
claims.title: Armed Forces Financial Network - Home
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Site footer shows © 2026 AFFN. Neither DCUC nor AMBA homepages carried 2024-2026 news items about AFFN on 2026-09-25.

claims.claim: The 2026 AFFN Matching Grant Program is the 23rd consecutive annual round since 2004, with 1,158 grants awarded to date.
claims.title: AFFN Matching Grant Program - AFFN
claims.label: Verified
